'''Ee-Ling Chu''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Sydney tournament]] on 14 October 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Ben May's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3055">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-sydney-14-10-01-from-another-perspectivd3055/ sydney-14-10-01-from-another-perspectiv], DeckTech (Ben "Hobbie65" May, 15 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-sydney-14-10-01-from-another-perspectivd3055/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
